headline.sentence: Nothing to collapse. 9 colors, 11 spacing steps, all on the grid.

drift.narrative: Nothing drifts in this system. It is built from nine colors, nine type styles and 11 spacing steps, and every spacing step sits on the grid. No colors sit near a neighbor, no type styles overlap and no component variants need collapsing. The proposed set keeps the same nine type styles and 11 spacing steps, with two grays. Every pair of text and background keeps its contrast ratio.
